caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of a woven textile pattern seen from above, with a plaid or tartan design consisting of horizontal and vertical stripes. The left side of the textile features predominantly black, white, pale green, yellow, and light brown stripes in a dense arrangement. Toward the center, the color scheme transitions to include more green, blue, and yellow shades, with stripes becoming slightly wider and more spaced apart. Further to the right, the pattern shifts to include a larger area filled with red, pink, peach, brown, yellow, and green horizontal and vertical stripes, mixed with occasional black lines. The overall composition is symmetrical in stripe placement, with distinct color transitions from left (cool and neutral tones) to right (warm tones), all bordered by a narrow, pale beige margin. The entire textile pattern is rendered using fine, parallel, and crosshatched lines to mimic the texture of woven fabric. There are no other objects or elements present in the image.
title: Rag Carpet
